# Blessings (Focus / Agility)

- **Status:** ⬜ Pending
- **Mechanic tags:** damage-pool, buff
- **Backlog:** `BLESSING-01` (see `docs/INGAME_VERIFICATION_BACKLOG.md`)

## Setup

Any modelled skill. Acquire Focus Blessing stacks (and separately Agility); set the same stack count in the app under Conditions. Parse at 0 vs max (4).

## Derived / confirmed formula

Focus = **+5% additional damage per stack**, stacks **ADD** → ×1.20 at 4 (NOT 1.05⁴). Agility = +4% Attack & Cast Speed and +2% additional damage per stack. Focus and Agility additional pools **multiply** with each other.

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Pending — engine modelled (user-set stacks), not game-verified.

## Implementation (engine model)

`aggregator.py::aggregate` applies each blessing's per-stack base effect × the user-set stack count from `_BLESSING_DEFAULT_EFFECTS`: Focus → `dmg_additional` 0.05/stack; Agility → `attack_speed_inc`/`cast_speed_inc` 0.04 + `dmg_additional` 0.02/stack; Tenacity → `dmg_taken_additional` -0.04 (defensive). Stacks of ONE blessing ADD into one summed entry per stat (`amount = per_stack × stacks`), so Focus×4 = `dmg_additional` 0.20 as a single factor. Focus and Agility both feed `dmg_additional` but with DISTINCT source text, so `offense.py::_build_additional_factors` pools by affix identity and MULTIPLIES the two ×(1+x) factors (Focus and Agility additional pools multiply). Max stacks = `4 + max_<short>_blessing_stacks_flat`. `_BLESSING_OVERRIDES` (Sacrifice/Divine Grace) can re-base per-stack effects when the flag is active. Driven by user-set `focus_blessings`/`agility_blessings`/`tenacity_blessings` numeric conditions. `blessings_summary()` mirrors the same tables for the panel.
